description: Decode a license plate → VIN & vehicle — look up the VIN, year, make and model for a US plate. Example: carsxe_plate_decode({ plate: "7XER187", state: "CA", _apiKey: "your-key" })

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Defaults to "US".

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. "CA" (required for US plates)

name: carsxe_plate_decode
title: Carsxe Plate Decode
